source_snapshot.procedure: For every 3.84TB E1.S, run direct libaio 2MiB sequential read/write and 4KiB random read/write with iodepth16, numjobs16 and a time_based runtime placeholder.
source_snapshot.criteria: NVMe E1.S performance should reach the customer SPEC definition.

old_problem: The previous review blocked the entire case because `/dev/sdx`, runtime, preconditioning and the 3.84TB customer thresholds were not populated. The source already specifies the actual four workload types and concurrency. These missing values can be mandatory capacity-specific project bindings with a destructive authorization gate and an INCONCLUSIVE outcome when absent.
disposition_reason: ED-04 protects every raw-write target and requires OS/mount/RAID/data exclusion; ED-03 permits target IDs, runtime and customer limits as project inputs; ED-14 retains the approved formal duration rather than a smoke substitute; ED-15 prevents PASS without the 3.84TB-specific oracle; ED-19/ED-20 prohibit inheriting row446's identity or thresholds. The test review is therefore resolved but execution remains gated.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row447 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3037 and next formal queue row448/history3038.

The four commands define sequential versus random and read versus write coverage with fixed block sizes, direct libaio, queue depth 16 and 16 jobs; only the target, formal runtime and project oracle are placeholders.

The 3.84TB capacity must keep its own target matrix, preconditioning, endurance budget and customer thresholds because controller firmware, NAND geometry and overprovisioning can differ from the adjacent 1.92TB variant.

Official fio option semantics allow an explicit serial-bound filename and bounded runtime while retaining the Master workload; none of this authorizes raw writes before the safety proof and user confirmation.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row448 and verified its manifest identity; no fio benchmark, storage read/write, log clearing or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: NVMe E1.S 3.84TB capacity-specific four-profile direct FIO benchmark
test_case.purpose: Measure every approved 3.84TB E1.S independently under the source's four high-concurrency profiles and compare repeatable per-drive bandwidth, IOPS and latency with the 3.84TB customer specification while preserving data and endurance safety.
required_package: Pinned fio/libaio version and machine-readable output support
Nonboot, unmounted, non-swap, non-LVM, non-RAID, non-device-mapper, disposable and backed-up proof per namespace
Approved raw-versus-file policy, runtime, region/size/alignment, preconditioning/steady-state, repeat/order and cool-down
3.84TB-specific customer BW/IOPS/latency thresholds and endurance/thermal/power/SMART stop limits
test_case.test_command: For each serial-verified disposable 3.84TB namespace, replace `/dev/sdx` only with its approved stable path and `<time>` only with the approved formal duration. Preserve `--direct=1 --refill_buffers --norandommap --randrepeat=0 --ioengine=libaio --iodepth=16 --numjobs=16 --time_based --group_reporting` and run four separate jobs: 2MiB `read`, 2MiB `write`, 4KiB `randread`, and 4KiB `randwrite`, with the source job names. Capture JSON and health telemetry per device. Execute the full set for every approved 3.84TB E1.S only after the resolved target/job preview and projected write exposure receive explicit approval.
test_case.expected_result: All mapped 3.84TB E1.S devices complete every formal profile with no fio/device/media error, data-scope violation, unacceptable health/endurance delta or thermal/power fault. Each device's approved BW, IOPS and latency statistics meet the matching 3.84TB capacity/SKU customer thresholds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the independent 3.84TB identity matrix, all four profiles on every required device, approved runtime/preconditioning/repeats, raw per-drive results and the capacity-specific customer threshold table. Row446's 1.92TB thresholds, `fio --version`, aggregate-only output or missing project bindings cannot pass and yield INCONCLUSIVE.
safety_gate: Never execute `/dev/sdx` or infer a 3.84TB target from device enumeration order
Exclude all boot/EFI/mounted/swap/LVM/RAID/device-mapper/valuable-data targets with immutable identity evidence
Do not inherit the 1.92TB SPEC or endurance assumptions; show the capacity-specific resolved commands and write budget for approval
Bound exposure, monitor per-device health/temperature/power, preserve logs and never retry automatically
expected_evidence: Pinned fio/job identity and full 3.84TB serial/namespace/BDF/slot safety matrix
Capacity-specific runtime, region, preconditioning, steady-state, repeats/order and threshold table
Four complete JSON outputs per 3.84TB device including achieved depth and errors
Per-profile BW/IOPS/latency comparison without borrowing 1.92TB limits
test_case.recovery: At any target mismatch, data-scope concern, fio/media/device error, health/endurance breach or thermal/power limit, terminate the current and queued jobs, retain all evidence and prohibit further writes. Apply the approved storage restore/cleanup plan; never format, sanitize, rebuild RAID or auto-retry.

source_conflict.reason: DeepSeek narrows itself to safe discovery but does not contradict the Master. The review restores the four exact profiles and explicitly prevents the version check from being treated as coverage.

blocked.reason: The operation and four workload semantics are known. Capacity-specific targets, runtime, preconditioning and thresholds are safe project bindings under destructive no-run and INCONCLUSIVE gates.
